text:
nina: Quick postmortem follow-up from the late-night regression. We burned ~4% error budget on cluster-prod-2; main vector looks like long sequences + GC stalls. Need owners/timelines for remediation + SLO decision.

owen: Data point: p95 jumped to ~350ms during spike windows, p99 to ~1.2s. Correlated with seq>1200.

sam: I ran a short heap dump analysis; a few model-worker threads had long safepoint pauses. Suspect JVM flags + large ephemeral allocations from request-side tokenization.

monitor-bot: Alert history: latency-p95-prod triggered 03:10, 03:18, 03:46 UTC (3x). Incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/example/2026-03-23

nina: Proposed quick mitigations: 1) API-level guardrail to cap seq at 1200 with informative 429-like response and header explaining quota; 2) GC tuning on model workers; 3) dashboard panels per-model and per-customer tier; 4) keep SLO targets but reduce alert window to 10m; 5) schedule 90d seq distribution analysis. Assign folks?

own: I'll take the API guardrail. Will push a small route-middleware and a feature flag. ETA: canary in 1h, full roll tomorrow AM.

sam: I'll handle GC tuning and perf validation. Plan: adjust G1 flags, increase metaspace, run 6h soak on canary. ETA: changes tomorrow morning, soak complete tomorrow evening.

paul: I'll own dashboard work. Will add p95/p99 by model, 90d seq histogram, and error-budget trend per cluster. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

customer-success: If we change any SLA text we need a pre-approved advisory. For now we'll draft a soft advisory that explains we're investigating and list mitigations.

nina: SLO strategy: don't lower p95 target yet. Instead: add an SLA note in prod status page and shorten alert trigger from 30m to 10m for sustained p95>200ms. I'll write a short SLO-update PR for review. Owner: nina. ETA: Thu EOD.

own: Quick ask — can we add a temporary query to detect high-seq traffic per-customer? Something to auto-alert if any customer drives >5% of requests with seq>1000.

paul: Yes, I'll add that to dashboard and an alert rule. Query suggestion (PromQL):
```
(sum by(customer) (rate(redwood_request_count{env=\"prod\",seq_range=\">1000\"}[5m]))
/ sum by(customer) (rate(redwood_request_count{env=\"prod\"}[5m]))) * 100
```

sam: Note on recurrence: saw same pattern on 2026-02-14 and 2026-01-19. We should include a retro item to evaluate rate-limiting vs UX. Owner: sam + nina. ETA for retro notes: next Sprint planning.

nina: Action summary in thread:
- API guardrail (seq cap): owen - canary 1h - status: in progress
- GC tuning + soak: sam - canary tomorrow AM, soak 6h - status: assigned
- Dashboards/alerts: paul - ETA EOD tomorrow - status: assigned
- SLO doc + alert window change: nina - ETA Thu EOD - status: draft
- Customer advisory draft: customer-success - standby - status: on-hold
- Retro to assess quota vs UX: sam + nina - ETA next planning - status: backlog

own: I'll drop the guardrail PR link here when canary is up.

monitor-bot: Note: we've also scheduled the SLO sync for 10:00 UTC tomorrow to review the PR.

paul: Adding the 90d histogram to a temporary "incident-review" dashboard so oncall can check quickly.

nina: Thanks team — stick updates in this thread and in the SLO sync. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
